verdict.rationale: First-party docs state plainly that the SDK runs language, speech, and vision models on the device, that prompts, audio, and images stay local, and that it works with no network. The CLI also runs local models offline without an account. Hosted execution is an explicit opt-in (`--cloud`) and is never switched in silently, and a community reply on HN says it is fully local with no data collected. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that no telemetry or network traffic occurs (the 'no data collected' reply appears to come from the vendor), and broader hardware coverage, since the MetalRT engine needs Apple M3 or later and other Macs fall back to llama.cpp.
